m: Cook the brown rice (25 to 30 minutes).
Sauce: soy, oyster sauce and cornflour whisked with 3 tbsp water per serve.
Get a wok smoking hot. Stir-fry the prawns 1 minute a side until just pink, then set aside.
Add the broccoli, beans and capsicum with a splash of water and stir-fry 3 minutes until bright and just tender.
Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds, then the sauce. Bubble until glossy.
Toss the prawns back in with the spring onion and serve over rice.
l: Reheat until just hot so the prawns don't go rubbery.
g: Tamari instead of soy, a GF oyster sauce, 100% maize cornflour, and a separate wok for the GF batch.
